seo.title: High-Rise Glass Cleaning with Rope Access
seo.description: Inland high-rise glass cleaning by certified rope access technicians: safe, fast and cost-effective with no scaffolding needed.

hero.title: Rope Access Building Glass Cleaning by Inland
hero.body: High-rise buildings need special care, especially for exterior cleaning such as glass and facade walls. Inland provides building cleaning using rope access, a safe and efficient technique to reach hard-to-access areas without scaffolding.
hero.imageAlt: Inland rope access technicians cleaning high-rise glass

sections.title: Advantages of Rope Access
sections.imageAlt: Rope access technicians on a louvred facade

items.title: Fast and Efficient
items.text: Rope access lets our technicians move freely around the building, saving the time needed to erect and dismantle scaffolding — faster cleaning without compromising quality.

items.title: Proven Safety
items.text: Certified technicians work with standard safety equipment and twin-rope systems.

items.title: Cost Saving
items.text: No scaffolding or extra gondolas means a more efficient budget.

items.title: Suits Any Building
items.text: Offices, apartments, hotels, and facades with complex shapes.

items.title: Building Glass Cleaning
items.text: Building glass gets dirty from dust, pollution, and moss. Our high-quality glass cleaning leaves your building looking clean, bright, and professional.

items.title: Exterior Wall Cleaning
items.text: ACP, granite, and painted walls cleaned of stains and mould.

items.title: Sunshade & Decorative Facade Cleaning
items.text: Hard-to-reach facade elements cleaned safely using rope access.

sections.title: Safety Is Our Priority
sections.text: We understand the importance of safety when working at height. Inland applies the highest safety standards on every building cleaning project. Our technicians are fully equipped with protective gear and follow strict safety procedures to protect themselves and everyone around them.

sections.title: Building Glass Cleaning Cost Guide
rows: Extreme height, stepped or curved facades
sections.note: *General Greater Jakarta market ranges for 2026 compiled from various providers — not an official Inland quote. Exact pricing follows a site survey. Cost drivers: glass area, level of dirt, height, facade shape, and schedule.

items.q: How much does building glass cleaning cost per m²?
items.a: As a guide, Greater Jakarta market rates are typically IDR 15,000–50,000 per m², higher for mould-stained glass. Inland quotes an exact price after surveying the area, glass condition, and building height.

items.q: How often should building glass be cleaned?
items.a: Usually every 3–6 months; buildings near main roads, industrial areas, or the coast often need more frequent cleaning.
